# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.5

This release adds bounded native object browsing and tightens identity handling
for source-native queries. The public query surface remains read-only. GitHub
release assets remain the supported distribution path.

## Changes

- Add native object browsing to the SDK, CLI and advanced MCP. Browse pages
  return bounded identity and observed queryable-field metadata. They do not
  return field values, References or catalog-wide absence claims.
- Keep browse cursors bound to the same opened client, source cut and scope.
- Refuse unknown identifier-shaped selectors instead of falling back to a
  different unique object. Generic unique-object shorthand, known IDs, declared
  titles and explicit catalog-scoped absence remain supported.
- Bind shared exact field spans and immediate successor answer and anchor
  context to the selected native identity.
- Keep selector recognition bounded to declared aliases and direct `of` or
  `for` forms. This release does not add arbitrary name interpretation,
  automatic connectors or hosted deployment.

## Install

Requires Node.js 24 or newer:

```bash
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.5/oont-0.3.0-alpha.5.tgz
```

## Verify the download

Download `SHA256SUMS` alongside the archive, then run:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify oont-0.3.0-alpha.5.tgz --repo Doss-com/openontology
```

The source inventory is attached separately as `SOURCE-MANIFEST.json`. For
usage and alpha limits, see the [README](https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology#readme).
